children: Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (NSE:RELIANCE) raised fresh equity in a GDR IPO backed by anchors like Meta, Alphabet and Saudi PIF to cut ~$3bn net debt and repay Jio loans, while Jio growth (533.3M users, 285M 5G) and tariff hikes shape near‑term revenue and credit upgrades.
Previous Week Recap
Reliance GDR IPO Proceeds To Repay Loans
: RELIANCE GDR IPO issues only new shares; about Rs27,500 crore of proceeds will repay Jio loans, per offering documents.
Jio Platforms 5G Subscribers Rise
: RELIANCE: Jio Platforms reported 284.9M 5G subscribers in Q1 FY27; company-wide customers 533.3M as of June 30, 2026, with 285M 5G users and >60% of India’s data traffic.
GDR Options Build Leveraged Bets
: Two traders built leveraged positions in Reliance Industries GDR (RELIANCE) options exceeding 3% MWPL ahead of the Jio Platforms IPO; one peaked at 3.41%, the other at 3.17% before trimming.
IPO Proceeds To Cut Net Debt
: RELIANCE plans to use IPO proceeds to cut about $3 billion of net debt and support growth via free cash flow.
RELIANCE GDR 144A IPO Opens
: RELIANCE GDR 144A IPO opened Oct 21, 2026 and closed Oct 23, 2026. Anchor bids were on Oct 19, 2026. Fresh issue; anchors included Meta, Alphabet, Mubadala and Saudi PIF.
Deferred Spectrum Payments Excluded

: RELIANCE says deferred spectrum payments of ₹1.05 lakh crore to the government aren't in reported net debt; annual interest costs will continue to reflect these spectrum obligations despite the IPO.
Fitch Upgrades Reliance Rating
: Fitch upgraded Reliance Industries' local-currency issuer rating to A- from BBB+, citing lower capex across oil, gas, telecom and retail and Jio Platforms IPO proceeds expected for debt reduction.
Jamnagar Refiner EU-Bound Shipments
: RELIANCE: Jamnagar refinery supplied six of seven EU-bound cargoes in September 2026, serving as the main source for most EU-directed shipments that month.
Overseas Bids Exceed $20B
: Overseas investors including Fidelity, Allianz and Capital Group placed bids exceeding $20 billion for an offering tied to Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (RELIANCE).
Jio Tariffs To Rise 12–15%
: Analysts expect Reliance Jio tariffs to rise about 12–15% over the next 3–4 months, a factor seen affecting Jio Platforms’ near-term revenue outlook amid limited competition.
